title: The Future of IT Is Agentic: Inside Windows 365, Intune & Microsoft's AI Vision with Christiaan Brinkhoff
description:
Cloud PCs, Intune and agentic AI are reshaping how enterprise IT manages endpoints. Christiaan Brinkhoff, who helped build Azure Virtual Desktop and Windows 365 at Microsoft, explains for IT pros and decision makers how these platforms fit together and where AI agents, MCP and Graph are taking endpoint management. Learn which decisions keep your foundation future-proof.
In this episode
00:00 – Welcome and guest introduction01:41 – From FSLogix and Microsoft to Nerdio07:19 – Azure Virtual Desktop vs. Windows 36526:24 – Windows 365 Boot and the Windows App31:31 – Agentic AI and the future admin role53:52 – Intune, Graph and MCP69:20 – AI hardware, NPUs and cost77:39 – Rapid fire and closing advice
Key takeaways
Azure Virtual Desktop is the PaaS option with full control, while Windows 365 is the SaaS Cloud PC that democratizes VDI, and both can be combined.Endpoint management is moving toward task-specific AI agents with tightly scoped permissions and agentic identities, with admins orchestrating rather than clicking.MCP layered on top of Graph and a unified Copilot experience are seen as the path to more autonomous management, but training and change management are lagging behind.
Worth quoting
“I honestly believe that a product is the representation of the people and the culture who build it.” – Christiaan Brinkhoff (05:24)
“So imagine you have an agent that does like security, policy management for you, but you still in control of what that agent is doing. I think that's the important part.” – Christiaan Brinkhoff (44:00)
